verdict.rationale: Browser Use clearly versions its APIs. It publishes a v4 OpenAPI spec (version 4.0.0) served at /api/v4, lists v2, v3 and v4 specs in llms.txt, and gives guidance on choosing V4 versus V3. The other half of the story, a documented deprecation policy, has no evidence at all; the V3/V4 guidance is about trade-offs, not sunsetting. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, backward-compatibility or changelog commitments, and independent corroboration of version stability.
